messages:
Jordan (Acme): Hey team — after the org transfer yesterday our production service started getting 403s for project 'acme-prod'. Error in logs: `permission denied: caller lacks project.run` (request_id=rq_abc123). This began immediately after the transfer. We're blocked in prod, can someone help?

Maya - Support: ugh sorry about that, Jordan. Are you using API keys or SSO-issued tokens for those calls? Can you paste the raw error body and the request_id if you have it? I'll start an escalation while we investigate. :eyes:

Jordan (Acme): We're on SSO service-account tokens (IdP-issued). Paste from our app logs: ```{
  "error": {
    "code": 403,
    "message": "Permission denied: caller lacks iam.roles.run for project acme-prod",
    "request_id": "rq_abc123"
  }
}``` Also our Console no longer shows any project members for acme-prod under the new org — it looks like membership was stripped.

Maya - Support: thanks. Tagging Alex - EngOps and SRE-Jen to investigate. Alex, can you check whether the org-transfer re-mapping job might have dropped project bindings?

Alex - EngOps: pinged. Quick note: when an org transfer happens we attempt to re-map project-level role bindings from the source org to the destination org. If group IDs or role templates differ we fallback to removing the binding. Need audit logs and the transfer metadata. Jordan, can you export the transfer audit lines?

Jordan (Acme): pasted audit snippet: ```2026-03-07T18:02:12Z TRANSFER_START org_src=9876 org_dest=1234 project=acme-prod user=admin@acme.com
2026-03-07T18:02:15Z REWRITE_ROLE_BINDINGS project=acme-prod result=partial_fail removed_bindings=[group:acme-devs] request=rq_transfer_42
2026-03-07T18:02:16Z TRANSFER_COMPLETE project=acme-prod status=ok request=rq_transfer_42```

IDP-Bot: SAML group-sync completed for acme-devs -> mapped to redwood-group-523 at 2026-03-07T18:00:00Z.

SRE-Jen: repro checklist while we triage: 1) Have Jordan run a token introspect and paste the token scopes. 2) Try a direct Console API call from a browser session as a user who should have access. 3) Provide one example request_id (you gave rq_abc123) and we will pull request traces. Jordan, can you run: ```bash
# quick token check
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/acme-prod
```
and paste output?

Jordan (Acme): ran that, returned 403 with same request_id. Token introspect shows scopes ["openid","email"] only — seems like missing project-specific role scopes. We think the SSO mapping lost the project role assertion.

Alex - EngOps: ok found the problem in the transfer job logs — the transfer script attempted to map legacy role IDs (role:legacy.editor) to new org role templates, but the mapping table was empty for this source org because it was an older tenant. The script then removed the binding instead of applying a fallback role. We'll run a remap to restore bindings. Preparing a dry-run first.

Maya - Support: escalation created INC-2026-452, assigned to Alex (P1). Jordan, we'll coordinate timing for a fix — do you have a preferred maintenance window?

Jordan (Acme): ASAP, but if you need an exact window we can do tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC.

Alex - EngOps: planned remediation steps (dry-run first): ```bash
# dry-run to show what will be changed
redwood-admin remap-roles 
  --source-org 9876 
  --dest-org 1234 
  --project acme-prod 
  --mapping-file /tmp/mapping-9876-1234.json 
  --dry-run

# then apply if output looks good
redwood-admin remap-roles --source-org 9876 --dest-org 1234 --project acme-prod --mapping-file /tmp/mapping-9876-1234.json
```
I ran the dry-run in our staging cluster and it shows re-adding `group:acme-devs -> role:project.editor`. Will schedule the real run during Jordan's window and we will stream logs here. :white_check_mark:

Kiran - Product: Alex, please also capture a post-mortem note — customers shouldn't lose access on transfers like this. We need a safe default role mapping or a guard that preserves bindings until a manual review.

(Deployment-bot): scheduled job remap-roles-1782457 to run 2026-03-08T23:05:00Z (window requested).

Alex - EngOps: running remediation now (applying mapping). Streaming condensed output: ```[23:05:03] applying binding: group:acme-devs -> role:project.editor
[23:05:04] success: re-added 1 binding (request=rq_fix_001)
[23:05:05] validation: sample api call returns 200
```

Jordan (Acme): confirmed — our app calls are succeeding again, 200 responses for the same requests that were failing before. :tada: Request ids for validation: rq_fix_001 and new api call rq_def456. Console now shows proper member list for acme-prod.

Maya - Support: great news, marking INC-2026-452 as resolved. Alex/Kiran — please file the follow-up to add a fallback mapping and an alert if the remap table is empty during transfer.

Alex - EngOps: will create postmortem and a PR to the transfer script to avoid silent removals. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone. :handshake:

Jordan (Acme): thanks all — appreciate the quick fix! :white_check_mark:
